units.source_text: 暂时蒙眬入睡，柏木做了一梦，梦见他所养驯的那只中国猫，娇声地叫着向他走来。

en.t: After dozing off for a short while, Kashiwagi had a dream in which the Chinese cat he had tamed came walking toward him, mewing sweetly.

units.source_text: 他想，这是他带来送还三公主的，但又寻思为什么要送还她。

en.t: He thought that he had brought it back to return it to the Third Princess, but then wondered why he had to return it to her at all.

units.source_text: 忽然惊醒，他想：“这梦是什么意思呢？”

en.t: Suddenly startled awake, he thought, What can this dream mean?

units.source_text: 三公主惊恐万状，似觉这不是现实之事，悲愤填塞胸中，不知如何是好。

en.t: The Third Princess was utterly terrified, as though she felt this could not be real; grief and resentment filled her breast, and she did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 柏木对她说道：“你须知道：这总是不可逃避的宿世深缘。

en.t: Kashiwagi said to her, You must understand that this is a deep bond from a former life, one that cannot be escaped.

units.source_text: 我自己也不相信这是事实。”

en.t: I myself can hardly believe that this is real.

units.source_text: 便把那天傍晚在三公主不提防之中小猫的绳子掀起帘端之事讲给她听。

en.t: He then told her how, that evening, while the Third Princess was off her guard, the kitten's cord had lifted the edge of the curtain.

units.source_text: 三公主闻有此事，深悔疏忽，觉得自身命运太苦。

en.t: When the Third Princess heard this, she deeply regretted her carelessness and felt that her fate was unbearably cruel.

units.source_text: 她想：“今后有何面目再见源氏主君呢！”

en.t: She thought, How can I ever face Lord Genji again after this?

units.source_text: 便悲伤凄楚地啜泣起来，竟像一个小孩。

en.t: Then she began to sob in such sorrow and misery that she seemed just like a little child.

units.source_text: 柏木觉得万分对她不起，也很悲伤，便用自己拭泪的衣袖来替她拭泪，

en.t: Kashiwagi felt terribly guilty toward her and was deeply saddened too, so he used the sleeve with which he had wiped his own tears to wipe away hers.
